title: An explicit complex-level map realises the adjunction between derived base change and restriction
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma takes a ring map R -> R' and objects K of D(R) and M of D(R'), and asserts a canonical isomorphism R Hom_R(K, M) = R Hom_{R'}(K tensor^L_R R', M) (source lines 28762-28769). The proof is an explicit comparison at the level of complexes. It chooses a K-injective complex J^bullet of R'-modules representing M, a quasi-isomorphism J^bullet -> I^bullet with I^bullet a K-injective complex of R-modules, and a K-flat complex K^bullet of R-modules representing K (proof lines 28772-28775). It then considers the map from Hom^bullet(K^bullet tensor_R R', J^bullet) to Hom^bullet(K^bullet, I^bullet) (proof lines 28776-28780). The substantive part is the degreewise description: on degree n terms the map is the product over n = p + q of Hom_{R'}(K^{-q} tensor_R R', J^p) -> Hom_R(K^{-q}, I^p) obtained by precomposing with K^{-q} -> K^{-q} tensor_R R' and postcomposing with J^p -> I^p (proof lines 28781-28787). To conclude, the proof observes that it suffices to show the induced maps on cohomology are isomorphisms, namely that Hom_{D(R)}(K, M) = Hom_{D(R')}(K tensor^L_R R', M), which is true because derived base change is left adjoint to restriction by the tensor-Hom adjunction lemma (proof lines 28788-28795). The non-routine content is the degreewise formula for the comparison map together with the identification of its cohomology with the adjunction comparison.
